articles.title_en: Targeting hunger or votes? The political economy of humanitarian transfers in Malawi
articles.title_cn: 瞄准饥饿还是选票？马拉维人道主义转移支付的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: Do electoral considerations play a role in the targeting of humanitarian transfers? We analyze the targeting of direct cash and food transfers distributed in Malawi in response to an exceptionally poor harvest following a late and erratic rainy season of 2015/16. Combining household survey data on transfers with a remotely sensed measure of drought and with the results of the 2014 and 2019 parliamentary elections, we show that transfers were disproportionately targeted at marginal constituencies. Rather than distributing the transfers based solely on need or mobilizing its tribal base, the government attempted to persuade swing voters to support its candidates in the next elections. We find no evidence that this strategy was successful at increasing the vote of ruling party candidates in subsequent elections.
articles.abstract_cn: 选举考量在人道主义转移支付的瞄准中是否发挥作用？我们分析了马拉维在2015/16年雨季迟到且不规律导致收成异常糟糕后，所分配的现金和食品直接转移支付的瞄准情况。将转移支付的住户调查数据与遥感测量的干旱指标以及2014年和2019年议会选举结果相结合，我们表明转移支付不成比例地瞄准了边缘选区。政府并非仅基于需求分配转移支付或动员其部落基础，而是试图说服摇摆选民在下次选举中支持其候选人。我们没有发现证据表明这一策略在增加执政党候选人在后续选举中的选票方面是成功的。

articles.title_en: Effects of education on political engagement in rural Burkina Faso
articles.title_cn: 教育对布基纳法索农村地区政治参与的影响
articles.abstract_en: Many African countries are both consolidating their democratic institutions and continuing to expand mass primary schooling. In this context, citizens may be interested in the broad general effect of education on political engagement. Recent social science work estimating this effect has not arrived at consensus, with researchers suggesting the relationship may be context dependent, and could vary from positive to negative. We apply an instrumental variable (IV) approach, using Afrobarometer surveys in Burkina Faso over the 2008–2019 period, merged with data on the timing of school establishment at the village level. Individual schooling attainment is instrumented by whether a school was established in the village of residence when the person was seven years old. The data is finer than recent papers that estimate the relationship using national-level quasi-experiments where education access changed across birth cohorts or where an indirect proxy measure of education access varied across regions and birth cohorts. We find that the relationship appears to differ by gender: men exhibit a substantial negative effect of education on engagement, while women exhibit no sizable relationship. The null effect for women may be due to low power, as there is less variation in education outcomes for women in rural areas. The results suggest that gender may be an important mediator of the direction and magnitude of the complex relationship between education and political engagement in polities with low overall levels of schooling.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多非洲国家既在巩固其民主制度，也在继续扩大初等教育的普及。在此背景下，公民可能关注教育对政治参与的广泛总体效应。近期估算这一效应的社会科学研究尚未达成共识，研究者认为这种关系可能依赖于具体情境，并可能从正向到负向变化。我们采用工具变量（IV）方法，使用2008-2019年期间布基纳法索的非洲晴雨表调查数据，并与村庄层面学校建立时间的数据合并。个人受教育程度以居住村庄在该人七岁时是否建立学校作为工具变量。该数据比近期使用国家级准实验（教育获取随出生队列变化或教育获取的间接代理指标随地区和出生队列变化）估算该关系的论文更为精细。我们发现这种关系似乎因性别而异：男性表现出教育对参与的显著负向效应，而女性则未表现出显著关系。女性的零效应可能归因于统计功效较低，因为农村地区女性的教育成果变异较小。结果表明，在总体教育水平较低的政治体中，性别可能是教育与社会参与之间复杂关系方向和程度的重要中介因素。

articles.title_en: The hierarchy of needs empirical examination of Maslow’s theory and lessons for development
articles.title_cn: 需求层次：马斯洛理论的实证检验及其对发展的启示
articles.abstract_en: Maslow’s needs theory proposes a hierarchy of needs and argues for their sequential satisfaction. The theory has been very influential in development studies, in the establishment of development priorities, in the design of policies and social programs, and in the role economic growth plays as central development instrument. This paper relies on a large and representative database from Mexico to empirically test four assumptions which are commonly associated to Maslow’s theory: that needs are satisfied sequentially, that income is a relevant resource in the satisfaction of relevant needs, that the hierarchy of needs is associated to their well-being contribution, and that Maslow’s proposed sequential path in the satisfaction of needs -beginning with the satisfaction of physiological ones and ending with the satisfaction of self-actualization ones- is the best possible one. Data on satisfaction of needs is used to address the first two assumptions, while a subjective well-being approach is used to deal with the last two assumptions. The four assumptions are rejected. In consequence, it is possible to think about strategies in the satisfaction of needs that do not follow the sequential satisfaction proposed by Maslow and which question the hierarchical order he proposed. The paper highlights the relevance of the needs of love and belonging and of esteem, and it argues for an integrated view of human beings and of their needs, as well as for following a balanced strategy in their satisfaction. Implications for development studies and for the design of sustainable development strategies and social programs are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 马斯洛的需求理论提出了需求的层次结构，并主张需求按顺序得到满足。该理论在发展研究、发展优先事项的确定、政策和社会项目的设计以及经济增长作为核心发展工具的作用方面具有很大影响力。本文利用墨西哥一个大型且具有代表性的数据库，对通常与马斯洛理论相关的四个假设进行实证检验：需求按顺序得到满足；收入是满足相关需求的重要资源；需求层次与其对福祉的贡献相关；马斯洛提出的需求满足顺序路径——从满足生理需求开始，以自我实现需求的满足结束——是最佳路径。使用需求满足的数据来处理前两个假设，而主观福祉方法用于处理后两个假设。四个假设均被拒绝。因此，可以设想不遵循马斯洛提出的顺序满足需求的策略，并质疑他提出的层次顺序。本文强调了爱与归属需求以及尊重需求的重要性，并主张对人类及其需求采取综合观点，以及在满足需求时遵循平衡策略。讨论了这对发展研究以及可持续发发展战略和社会项目设计的影响。

articles.abstract_en: In this paper we examine the interrelatedness between regime types of democracy and non-democracy and poverty reduction. The liberal international order and democratic principles have been challenged by the populace’s general discontent in recent years, while the reduction of poverty is a central goal of the global development agenda as embodied by the Sustainable Development Goals. Democracies could promote poverty reduction by encouraging redistribution, lifting barriers for poor people, or giving better access to the institutions of society. Democracies might hinder poverty reduction if they are captured by elites or become dysfunctional in general. Our data cover around 140 countries and a period from 1980–2018. We use a mix of methods to address endogeneity concerns. In dynamic panel estimates that control for past influences of poverty, GDP and inequality we find no significant impact of democratization – measured mainly by electoral democracy – on poverty rates. In more flexible and causal treatment effects estimates we find democratization reduces poverty rates by about 11–14% in the first five years after democratization on a 95% significance level and about 20% 10–14 years after democratization on a 90% significance level. Although we find mixed results, we are still confident that democratic political institutions matter greatly, and societies are better off when the political systems are more inclusive. The fact that our results do not find clear support for this suggest that electoral democracy – without further aspects considering the level of democracy – does not have a clear-cut effect on poverty.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了民主与非民主政体类型与减贫之间的相互关联性。近年来，自由国际秩序和民主原则受到民众普遍不满的挑战，而减少贫困是全球发展议程的核心目标，如可持续发展目标所体现的那样。民主国家可能通过鼓励再分配、消除穷人面临的障碍或提供更好的社会制度准入来促进减贫。如果民主被精英俘获或总体上功能失调，则可能阻碍减贫。我们的数据涵盖约140个国家，时间跨度为1980-2018年。我们采用多种方法来解决内生性问题。在控制贫困、GDP和不平等过去影响的动态面板估计中，我们发现民主化（主要以选举民主衡量）对贫困率没有显著影响。在更灵活和因果性的处理效应估计中，我们发现民主化在民主化后头五年内使贫困率降低约11-14%，显著性水平为95%；在民主化后10-14年降低约20%，显著性水平为90%。尽管结果不一，我们仍然相信民主政治制度至关重要，当政治体系更具包容性时，社会状况会更好。我们的结果未找到明确支持这一点的证据，这表明选举民主——在不考虑民主水平的其他方面的情况下——对贫困没有明确的影响。

articles.title_en: With and beyond sustainability certification: Exploring inclusive business and solidarity economy strategies in Peru and Switzerland
articles.title_cn: 超越可持续性认证：探索秘鲁和瑞士的包容性商业与团结经济策略
articles.abstract_en: Certification of sustainability standards is an important governance strategy aimed at enhancing the human well-being outcomes of agri-food value chains. While the impacts of certification on well-being are positive for some farmers under certain conditions, they are insignificant or adverse for others. Many barriers can impede positive impacts of certification on well-being. Alternative or complementary strategies such as inclusive business and solidarity economy may challenge these barriers. However, since certification, inclusive business and solidarity economy strategies are studied in isolation, their precise similarities and differences, their interplay and their relative efficacy and limitations remain elusive. Therefore, this paper explores to what extent and how inclusive business and solidarity economy strategies may overcome the persistent governance and economic barriers that limit well-being impacts of certification. We explore four purposively selected cases of inclusive business and solidarity economy strategies from the cacao value chains connecting Peru and Switzerland. Results show that value chain actors combine different specific elements of the three strategies (certification, inclusiveness and solidarity) into portfolios of instruments, which reflect their value chain role and organizational missions. These instrument portfolios may address some of the barriers of certification schemes, but they come with their own challenges and limitations. We conclude that promising future research may use comparative research designs to disentangle specific instruments of inclusiveness, solidarity, and certification; to build typologies of instrument portfolios; to understand their interaction with systemic change in markets and land-use systems; and to specify the conditions under which value chain actors can use specific instruments to improve well-being outcomes of agri-food value chains.
articles.abstract_cn: 可持续性标准认证是一种重要的治理策略，旨在提升农业食品价值链的人类福祉成果。虽然认证对福祉的影响在某些条件下对部分农民是积极的，但对其他人而言则不显著或不利。许多障碍可能阻碍认证对福祉产生积极影响。替代或补充策略，如包容性商业和团结经济，可能挑战这些障碍。然而，由于认证、包容性商业和团结经济策略被孤立研究，它们之间的精确相似性与差异性、相互作用以及相对效力和局限性仍然难以捉摸。因此，本文探讨包容性商业和团结经济策略在多大程度上以及如何可能克服限制认证福祉影响的持续治理和经济障碍。我们探讨了连接秘鲁和瑞士的可可价值链中四个有目的选择的包容性商业和团结经济策略案例。结果表明，价值链参与者将三种策略（认证、包容性和团结）的不同具体要素组合成工具组合，这反映了他们的价值链角色和组织使命。这些工具组合可能解决认证计划的一些障碍，但它们也带来了自身的挑战和局限性。我们得出结论，有前景的未来研究可能使用比较研究设计来区分包容性、团结和认证的具体工具；构建工具组合的类型学；理解它们与市场和土地利用系统系统性变化的互动；并明确价值链参与者可以使用特定工具改善农业食品价值链福祉成果的条件。

articles.title_en: Blessed are the peacemakers: The future burden of intrastate conflict on poverty
articles.title_cn: 和平缔造者有福了：国内冲突对贫困的未来负担
articles.abstract_en: Intrastate conflict generally undermines human development but its effect on global poverty across different income thresholds remains poorly understood. This paper analyzes how many people will live in poverty due to intrastate civil conflict in 2030, 2050, and 2070 using the International Futures model and shared socioeconomic pathways, forecasting 12 scenarios for 179 countries. A baseline conflict scenario leads to an additional 148.2 million (range: 50.7 to 186.0 million) people living in extreme poverty (<$1.90 per day) due to conflict by 2030 compared with a scenario where conflict is eliminated starting in 2022. These conflict-attributable poor represent 20.1% of the population in extreme poverty at that time, with the majority living in South Asia followed by Africa. By 2050 the population living in conflict-attributable poverty increases to 164.9 million (range: 4.4 to 376.5 million), representing 32.7% of the total extremely poor population at that time with the majority living in Africa. While future conflict will be responsible for hundreds of millions of people living in poverty, its elimination is not a panacea for achieving development targets: even in a scenario with no intrastate conflict from 2022 to 2030 the population living in extreme poverty is projected to be 6.9%, well above the target threshold of 3% for achieving the first Sustainable Development Goal.
articles.abstract_cn: 国内冲突通常会削弱人类发展，但其对不同收入门槛下全球贫困的影响仍知之甚少。本文利用国际未来模型和共享社会经济路径，分析了到2030年、2050年和2070年因国内冲突而陷入贫困的人数，预测了12个国家的179种情景。与从148.2年起消除冲突的情景相比，基线冲突情景到50.7年将导致额外186.0亿人（范围：1.90万至2030亿人）生活在极端贫困中（每日低于2022美元）。这些因冲突致贫的人口占当时极端贫困人口的20.1%，其中大多数生活在南亚，其次是非洲。到2050年，因冲突致贫的人口增加到164.9亿（范围：4.4万至376.5亿），占当时极端贫困总人口的32.7%，其中大多数生活在非洲。尽管未来冲突将导致数亿人陷入贫困，但消除冲突并非实现发展目标的万能药：即使在2022年至2030年无国内冲突的情景下，极端贫困人口预计仍占6.9%，远高于实现第一个可持续发展目标所需的3%的目标门槛。

articles.title_cn: 粮食不安全库兹涅茨曲线？
articles.abstract_en: Advances in food security proceed unevenly within and across nations. A striking pattern emerges from analysis of >560,000 individual responses to the first globally comparable, nationally representative, repeated food insecurity survey, which is statistically representative of >96 % of the world’s population. We find the relationship between the prevalence of food insecurity in a country and intranational, interpersonal inequality in food insecurity follows a strong inverse-U shape, i.e., a Kuznets Curve. The relationship is stable over time and across relevant inequality measures and estimation methods. This finding can help guide the implementation of safety nets and social protection programs to achieve the UN’s Sustainable Development Goal 2 and to satisfy the human right enshrined in Article 25 of the 1948 Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
articles.abstract_cn: 各国内部和各国之间粮食安全的进展并不均衡。对首次全球可比较、具有全国代表性的重复粮食不安全调查的>560,000个人反应进行分析，得出了一个惊人的模式，该调查在统计上代表了>96%的世界人口。我们发现，一个国家粮食不安全的普遍程度与粮食不安全的国内、人际不平等之间的关系遵循强烈的倒U形，即库兹涅茨曲线。随着时间的推移以及相关不平等措施和估计方法，这种关系是稳定的。这一发现有助于指导安全网和社会保护计划的实施，以实现联合国可持续发展目标 2 并满足 1948 世界人权宣言第 25 条所载的人权。

articles.title_en: Disaster mortalities and the Sendai Framework Target A: Insights from Zimbabwe
articles.title_cn: 灾害死亡率与仙台框架目标A：来自津巴布韦的见解
articles.abstract_en: In many parts of the world, human losses to disasters have been on the increase during the past three decades. This has slowed down the human development process. In an attempt to curb disaster impact, the world adopted an action-oriented Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction (SFDRR) in 2015. Target A of the SFDRR seeks to substantially reduce disaster mortalities by 2030. This study contributes to the SFDRR by bringing in disaster-disaggregated mortality data to assess the progress of Zimbabwe’s commitment in attaining Target A. The data came from the Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency, the Traffic Safety Council of Zimbabwe, the Department of Civil Protection and the EM-DAT database. To analyse the data, we conducted 3-year and 5-year moving averages for a period of thirty years to frame a holistic picture of the disaster mortalities in Zimbabwe. We also applied the methodology developed by the Open-Ended Intergovernmental Expert Working Group to determine the mortality rates for the overall and individual disaster type. Results clearly showed that Zimbabwe is making progress in reducing disaster mortalities despite a few spikes across its range of disasters. Major deaths were caused by drought, diarrhoea, malaria and tropical cyclones. Therefore, Zimbabwe needs to invest in drought monitoring and mitigation, cyclone forecasting and early warnings, and the surveillance and prevention of diarrhoeal diseases and malaria in order to substantially reduce the disaster mortality by the year 2030.
articles.abstract_cn: 在世界许多地区，过去三十年间灾害造成的人员损失持续增加。这减缓了人类发展进程。为遏制灾害影响，世界于2015年通过了以行动为导向的《仙台减少灾害风险框架》（SFDRR）。SFDRR的目标A旨在到2030年大幅降低灾害死亡率。本研究通过引入按灾害类型分类的死亡率数据，评估津巴布韦在实现目标A方面的承诺进展，从而为SFDRR做出贡献。数据来源于津巴布韦国家统计局、津巴布韦交通安全委员会、民防部以及EM-DAT数据库。为分析数据，我们计算了三十年期间的3年和5年移动平均值，以全面描绘津巴布韦灾害死亡率的情况。我们还采用了开放式政府间专家工作组开发的方法，以确定总体及各类灾害的死亡率。结果清楚表明，尽管津巴布韦在各类灾害中偶有峰值，但其在降低灾害死亡率方面正取得进展。主要死亡原因包括干旱、腹泻、疟疾和热带气旋。因此，津巴布韦需要投资于干旱监测与缓解、气旋预报与预警，以及腹泻病和疟疾的监测与预防，以便到2030年大幅降低灾害死亡率。

articles.title_en: Community matters: Heterogeneous impacts of a sanitation intervention
articles.title_cn: 社区至关重要：一项卫生干预措施的异质性影响
articles.abstract_en: Sanitation is at the heart of public health policies in most of the developing world, where around 85% of the population still lack access to safe sanitation. We study the effectiveness of a widely adopted participatory community-level information intervention aimed at improving sanitation. Results from a randomized controlled trial, implemented at scale in rural Nigeria, reveal stark heterogeneity in impacts: the intervention has immediate, strong and lasting effects on sanitation practices in less wealthy communities, realized through increased sanitation investments. In contrast, we find no evidence of impacts among wealthier communities. This suggests that a targeted implementation of CLTS may increase its effectiveness in improving sanitation. Our findings can be replicated in other contexts, using microdata from evaluations of similar interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 卫生是大多数发展中国家公共卫生政策的核心，这些国家中约有85%的人口仍然无法获得安全的卫生设施。我们研究了一项广泛采用的、以社区为基础的参与式信息干预措施在改善卫生方面的有效性。一项在尼日利亚农村大规模实施的随机对照试验的结果揭示了影响的显著异质性：该干预措施在较不富裕的社区中对卫生实践产生了即时、强烈且持久的影响，这是通过增加卫生投资实现的。相比之下，我们在较富裕的社区中没有发现影响的证据。这表明，有针对性地实施CLTS可能会提高其在改善卫生方面的有效性。我们的发现可以在其他背景下复制，使用类似干预措施评估的微观数据。

articles.title_en: The role of mobile money in household resilience: Evidence from Kenya
articles.title_cn: 移动货币在家庭韧性中的作用：来自肯尼亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: •Results indicate a positive effect of mobile money on household resilience metric.•A 10 km drop in the distance user-agent increases resilience by a percentage point.•Study finds that mobile money users are more likely to withstand severe shocks.•Findings establish new evidence on the long-run effect of digital payments.
articles.abstract_cn: •结果表明移动货币对家庭韧性指标具有正向影响。•用户代理距离每减少10公里，韧性提高一个百分点。•研究发现移动货币用户更有可能抵御严重冲击。•研究结果为数字支付的长期效应提供了新证据。

articles.title_en: Market concentration, trade exposure, and firm productivity in developing countries: Evidence from Mexico
articles.title_cn: 发展中国家市场集中度、贸易开放度与企业生产率：来自墨西哥的证据
articles.abstract_en: To show how local market concentration affects firm productivity, we exploit a rare database for developing-country standards consisting of five rounds of the Mexican Manufacturing Census and geographically disaggregated data on sectoral exports. Our estimates show that a decline by 10 points in the Herfindahl-Hirschman index, a measure of market concentration, explains an increase by 1 percent in the total factor productivity (TFP) of revenue. We also find that greater exposure to trade offsets and, in most cases, reverses the negative effects of local concentration on productivity. Our heterogeneity analysis also shows that informal firms exhibit a higher probability of exiting the market if competitive pressure and exposure to international markets increase and that firms in the southern region of the country would benefit the most from higher competition and exposure to international markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 为展示本地市场集中度如何影响企业生产率，我们利用了一个罕见的发展中国家标准数据库，该数据库包含五轮墨西哥制造业普查以及地理细分层面的部门出口数据。我们的估计显示，赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（衡量市场集中度的指标）下降10个百分点，可解释收入全要素生产率（TFP）提高1%。我们还发现，更大的贸易开放度抵消并在多数情况下逆转了本地集中度对生产率的负面影响。我们的异质性分析还表明，如果竞争压力和国际市场开放度增加，非正规企业退出市场的概率更高，且该国南部地区的企业将从更高的竞争和国际市场开放度中获益最多。

articles.title_en: Multidimensional forests: Complexity of forest-based values and livelihoods across Amazonian socio-cultural and geopolitical contexts
articles.title_cn: 多维森林：亚马逊社会文化与地缘政治背景下森林价值与生计的复杂性
articles.abstract_en: Research on the contribution of forests to local livelihoods has so far had a strong focus on quantifying the monetary value of forest-derived products and services. In this paper, we move beyond monetary valuation and integrate the less tangible and sometimes culturally complex dimensions through which forests support local livelihoods. We look at four local contexts in the Brazilian, Bolivian and Ecuadorian Amazon, which differ markedly in terms of their biophysical, sociocultural and geopolitical settings. Combining economic and anthropological data, we used quantitative and qualitative methods, and measures of the ecological impacts of local forest uses. Quantitative analyses drew on datasets from 48 communities, and 510 households, while the qualitative analyses relied on semi-structured interviews with 78 families in 22 communities. Forest-based livelihoods exhibited complex portfolios, diversified production systems, seasonal variation of activities, and different specialization strategies. Beyond a source of subsistence and cash incomes, forests were locally valued by people across all sites in terms of identities, worldviews, territorial attachment, governance, and conservation. Populations with a longer history of interactions with the environment displayed more complex forest-related cultural systems, but even among people who had migrated into the forest in a more recent historical period, forest-based self-cultural identification was evident. At all sites, forests were unanimously recognized as critical to people’s health and wellbeing, despite substantial differences in local histories, policy and market environments. The findings underscore the persistent importance of non-economic values of forests as both Indigenous and non-Indigenous groups constantly adapt their forest and land use practices based on transcultural exchange and changing conditions. A focus on economic value as the rationale for forest conservation disregards the striking resilience of cultural values in promoting forest conservation and use by diverse local and Indigenous communities, especially when supported by favorable policies and markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于森林对当地生计贡献的研究迄今主要集中于量化森林产品与服务的货币价值。在本文中，我们超越货币估值，整合森林支持当地生计的较少有形且有时文化复杂的维度。我们考察了巴西、玻利维亚和厄瓜多尔亚马逊的四个地方背景，这些背景在生物物理、社会文化和地缘政治环境方面存在显著差异。结合经济与人类学数据，我们使用了定量和定性方法，以及当地森林利用的生态影响度量。定量分析基于48个社区和510个家庭的数据集，而定性分析依赖于对22个社区中78个家庭的半结构化访谈。以森林为基础的生计表现出复杂的组合、多样化的生产系统、活动的季节性变化以及不同的专业化策略。除了作为生计和现金收入的来源外，森林在所有地点都被当地人在身份认同、世界观、领土归属、治理和养护方面赋予价值。与环境互动历史较长的群体表现出更复杂的森林相关文化体系，但即使在较近期迁入森林的人群中，基于森林的自我文化认同也很明显。在所有地点，尽管当地历史、政策和市场环境存在显著差异，森林被一致认为是人们健康和福祉的关键。研究结果强调了森林非经济价值的持久重要性，因为原住民和非原住民群体不断根据跨文化交流和变化条件调整其森林和土地利用实践。将经济价值作为森林养护理由的关注忽视了文化价值在促进多样地方和原住民社区森林养护与利用方面的显著韧性，尤其是在有利政策和市场支持下。

articles.title_en: Stakeholder perspectives on cocoa’s living income differential and sustainability trade-offs in Ghana
articles.title_cn: 利益相关者对加纳可可生活收入差价与可持续性权衡的看法
articles.abstract_en: Policy responses to balance the trade-offs between nature conservation and socioeconomic development have recently come to the fore in Ghana – the world’s second largest producer of cocoa. In 2019, the Government of Ghana introduced the Living Income Differential (LID), which requires buyers to pay an additional US$400 per ton of cocoa on top of the floor price. With low farmer incomes identified as a critical driver of multiple sustainability issues in Ghana’s cocoa sector, this differential is meant to be directly transferred to cocoa farmers in response to the persistent challenge of poverty in cocoa farming communities. Using the Q methodology, we engaged over 50 stakeholders from various levels (international policy experts, cocoa sector stakeholders in Ghana, and cocoa farmers) to understand how the LID is perceived, including its potential to transform the rural poverty complex embedded in Ghana’s cocoa supply chain. While the LID is lauded for increasing producer price across the board, our findings indicate that the lack of regard for farmer diversity (i.e., tenure rights, sharecroppers, and caretakers), farm size, and land management strategies (agroforestry versus clearing forest to establish farms) risks undermining the ability of this pricing mechanism to reduce farmer poverty. Further, the LID is siloed from on-going sustainability governance efforts in the sector, such as zero deforestation cocoa. If the LID is delivered to farmers across the board without any quid pro quo for how cocoa is produced, the policy’s unintended consequences may include increasing deforestation in the short term, while lowering the world market price of cocoa in the long term as cocoa supply increases. We conclude with policy implications on why different perspectives matter in managing sustainability trade-offs in deforestation frontiers.
articles.abstract_cn: 平衡自然保护与社会经济发展之间权衡的政策响应最近在加纳——世界第二大可可生产国——成为焦点。2019年，加纳政府引入了生活收入差价（LID），要求买家在最低价格之上每吨可可额外支付400美元。鉴于农民收入低被确定为加纳可可部门多个可持续性问题的关键驱动因素，这一差价旨在直接转移给可可农民，以应对可可种植社区持续存在的贫困挑战。采用Q方法，我们与来自不同层级（国际政策专家、加纳可可部门利益相关者以及可可农民）的50多名利益相关者进行了接触，以了解LID如何被感知，包括其改变加纳可可供应链中根深蒂固的农村贫困复合体的潜力。尽管LID因全面提高了生产者价格而受到赞誉，但我们的研究结果表明，对农民多样性（即土地保有权、分成佃农和看护人）、农场规模和土地管理策略（农林复合经营与清理森林建立农场）缺乏考虑，可能会削弱这一定价机制减少农民贫困的能力。此外，LID与部门内正在进行的可持续性治理努力（如零毁林可可）相互孤立。如果LID不加区别地提供给所有农民，而不对可可生产方式提出任何交换条件，该政策的意外后果可能包括短期内增加毁林，而长期内随着可可供应增加而降低世界市场价格。我们最后总结了政策启示，说明在毁林前沿地带管理可持续性权衡时，不同视角为何重要。

articles.title_en: Fighting against hunger: A country-wide intervention and its impact on birth outcomes
articles.title_cn: 抗击饥饿：一项全国性干预及其对出生结局的影响
articles.abstract_en: In 2013 the Mexican government launched Sin Hambre (SH), a large-scale food assistance policy, with which to fight hunger, and which the government expressly intended to improve nutrition and access to food. This study applies a difference-in-differences approach using timing and regional variations in exposure to evaluate the impact of SH, particularly on average birthweight. Because municipalities were not selected randomly, the approach employs a method proposed by Imai et al. (2021) that improves the confidence to satisfy the parallel trend assumption under staggered adoption. Findings reveal that exposure to SH leads to, at most, moderate impacts on birthweight across various specifications.
articles.abstract_cn: 2013年，墨西哥政府启动了“无饥饿”（Sin Hambre, SH）这一大规模食品援助政策，旨在抗击饥饿，并明确意图改善营养和食物获取。本研究采用双重差分方法，利用暴露时间的先后和地区差异来评估SH政策的影响，特别是对平均出生体重的影响。由于市政当局并非随机选择，该方法采用了Imai等人（2021年）提出的方法，在交错采用的情况下提高满足平行趋势假设的信心。研究结果显示，在各种设定下，暴露于SH政策对出生体重的影响至多为中等程度。

articles.title_en: Productivity gaps at formal and informal microfirms
articles.title_cn: 正规与非正规微型企业的生产率差距
articles.abstract_en: Although evidence of a productivity gap between formal and informal firms has been observed, this “formality premium” has been less explored for microfirms. The informality of microfirms is a central concern in low- and middle-income countries, leading to a crucial demand for designing economic policies addressing this issue. We fill this void by estimating a productivity premium for the case of Colombia, considering two margins of formality for microfirms: extensive, referring to business registration, and intensive, which includes labor regulations. We use a unique longitudinal dataset from the Microenterprise Survey by the Colombian Statistics Department, which follows approximately 39,000 micro-establishments with up to nine employees during 2012–2016. We utilize the transition into and out of formality to estimate the productivity premium (yearly sales per worker) between informal and formal firms, thereby exploring differences concerning initial productivity. We use a fixed-effects quantile regression to explore differential effects along the productivity distribution. We find evidence of a premium for both the extensive (18%) and intensive margins (7%), a gap that decreases with a firm’s productivity when considering a strict definition of formality. The evidence of these premiums is related to two growth strategies of firms: an increase in capital investments for the extensive margin and an increase in human capital quality for the intensive margin. Further, we find the premium is notably wider for young firms (less than three years in the business) relative to the older; and for the least productive ‘necessity’ driven businesses in comparison with the business-driven businesses. We do not find systematic differences according to the gender of the owners. These results are new evidence to support the existence of a premium and the transition into and out of formality for microfirms in middle-income countries. Moreover, they suggest that microfirms’ formalization and growth policies should be oriented toward promoting and enhancing formality’s benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管已有证据表明正规与非正规企业之间存在生产率差距，但这种“正规性溢价”在微型企业中研究较少。微型企业的非正规性是低收入和中等收入国家的一个核心关切，因此迫切需要设计解决这一问题的经济政策。我们通过估算哥伦比亚案例中的生产率溢价来填补这一空白，考虑了微型企业正规性的两个维度：广泛边际（指企业注册）和密集边际（包括劳动法规）。我们使用了哥伦比亚统计部门微观企业调查中的独特纵向数据集，该调查在2012-2016年间跟踪了约39,000家雇员不超过九人的微型企业。我们利用企业进入和退出正规性的转变来估算非正规与正规企业之间的生产率溢价（每位员工的年销售额），从而探讨与初始生产率相关的差异。我们使用固定效应分位数回归来探索生产率分布上的异质性效应。我们发现，广泛边际（18%）和密集边际（7%）均存在溢价，且在采用严格的正规性定义时，这一差距随企业生产率的提高而缩小。这些溢价的证据与企业的两种增长策略相关：广泛边际对应资本投资的增加，密集边际对应人力资本质量的提升。此外，我们发现年轻企业（经营年限不足三年）的溢价明显高于老企业；而生产率最低的“生存型”企业相比“机会型”企业溢价更高。我们没有发现所有者性别方面的系统性差异。这些结果为新证据，支持中等收入国家微型企业存在正规性溢价以及进入和退出正规性的转变。此外，它们表明，微型企业的正规化和增长政策应旨在促进和增强正规性的益处。

articles.title_en: Are smart cities green? The role of environmental and digital policies for Eco-innovation in China
articles.title_cn: 智慧城市是否绿色？环境与数字政策对中国生态创新的作用
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we employ negative binomial and quasi-natural experimental methods (i.e., Difference-in-Differences and Propensity Score Matching), whereby we examine the joint impact of environmental and digital policies (for designing smart cities) upon the generation of eco-innovations in China. Using longitudinal data for the period 2006–2018, we examine the changes in green patents granted: (i) due to the implementation of various levels of stringency of environmental policies across all cities; and (ii) after the introduction of smart city policies in 2012 in China. The prior literature stresses the importance of environmental policies, yet less attention has been paid to digital policies required to drive eco-innovation and their spatial dimension in the context of a developing economy. Our results show that, when digital policies (artificial intelligence and internet of things) are implemented in cities that have adopted strict environmental policies, the production of green patents increases. We contribute to debates in the literature of policy mix for sustainability transitions in the context of a developing economy by illustrating the importance of both types of policy for eco-innovation, as they correct two market failures and, more importantly, address the systemic coordination problems that occur during the production of green patents.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们采用负二项回归和准自然实验方法（即双重差分法和倾向得分匹配法），考察了环境与数字政策（用于设计智慧城市）对中国生态创新产生的联合影响。利用2006-2018年期间的面板数据，我们考察了绿色专利授予的变化：（i）由于各城市实施不同严格程度的环境政策；（ii）中国于2012年引入智慧城市政策之后。先前文献强调了环境政策的重要性，但对推动生态创新所需的数字政策及其在发展中经济体背景下的空间维度关注较少。我们的结果表明，当在已采取严格环境政策的城市实施数字政策（人工智能和物联网）时，绿色专利的产出会增加。我们通过说明这两类政策对生态创新的重要性，为发展中经济体背景下可持续转型政策组合的文献讨论做出贡献，因为它们纠正了两种市场失灵，更重要的是，解决了绿色专利生产过程中出现的系统性协调问题。
